sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r12/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks sheet row 23 = check 22; Internal Quality Checks sheet row 23; Deterministic Checks rows 11 check-dockerfiles.py and 32 check-runtime-deps-in-both-images.py)

.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r12/rules/projects/webdev-task-template (tests/Dockerfile, tests/test.sh, tests/.dockerignore, tests/tools/*, environment/Dockerfile, task.toml, tests/scoring.toml, diffed against the task)
evidence: Static review: tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template (diff empty), as are tests/test.sh, .dockerignore, tools/restart_mcp.py, tools/score.py, scoring.toml and environment/Dockerfile. Every item the row names is shipped. Judge CLI: tests/Dockerfile:17 '@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281' (matches REWARDKIT_JUDGE = "claude-code", task.toml:31). Playwright: tests/Dockerfile:19 '@playwright/mcp@0.0.79', invoked by every judge.toml as command = "playwright-mcp". Browser: tests/Dockerfile:33-38 installs chromium with the Playwright CLI bundled inside that pinned MCP package ('node "$PW_CLI" install --with-deps chromium'), makes it world-readable and links it to /usr/local/bin/chromium, which is exactly the '--executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium' the judge.toml files pass; the browser revision is therefore fixed transitively by the exact MCP version. RewardKit: tests/Dockerfile:31 'harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7'. python3 for the restart server: base 'python:3.12-slim' (line 2) provides /usr/local/bin/python3, the path functional/judge.toml uses for restart_mcp.py; the node /usr/local overlay on line 4 adds to it and does not remove it. App runtime: Node 22 copied from 'node:22-bookworm-slim' (lines 1, 4), 'express@5.1.0' and 'better-sqlite3@12.4.1' (lines 20-21) with NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules (line 9) - the same two packages and versions as environment/Dockerfile:10-11, so check-runtime-deps-in-both-images holds by hand. test.sh needs setpriv/setsid (util-linux, line 13), timeout (coreutils) and python3, all present. The golden's server.js requires only node:path, node:fs, express and better-sqlite3 (server.js:2-5); its frontend is prebuilt under public/assets and the public HTML has no external URL, so the Oracle needs nothing the image lacks. Conforming alternative checked: an app that needs other packages at runtime (the brief says 'Include everything needed at runtime', integration.md:5) carries them in /app/node_modules, which test.sh copies with 'cp -a /app/. "$APP_COPY/"', so it also starts. Broken app checked: an app that needs an install or build step does not start in this image and is zeroed by the readiness loop, which is the intended outcome. Run evidence: the hosted run on an EARLIER candidate (reward.json: render 1.0, constraints 1.0, functional 1.0, polish 1.0, visual 0.9167, graded 1; app.log 'Colderwater ready on port 3000') shows this template image can launch an app, drive the browser and write a graded reward. The scripted golden on these bytes ran in the agent image, not the verifier image (raw-evidence-index limitation: 'Ran in the agent image, not through tests/test.sh in the verifier image'). So no verifier-image build or run exists for these exact bytes; that required measurement is missing and the row stays risk=true. Non-blocking notes, all template-controlled and not task defects: base images are tag-pinned not digest-pinned; apt packages and the '--with-deps' browser libraries are unpinned (workbook Deterministic row 11 treats unpinned apt as a NOTE); '@openai/codex@0.151.0' is installed but unused by this judge.
